images.caption: Shankill Caravan Park This used to be a popular destination for camping and caravanners as it was the nearest site to the Dun Laoghaire ferry terminal 7Km away. The site was closed in 2004 and a development of executive flats now known as Olcavar replaced it within 2 years.
